name: copilotprompts-prompt-m365-clean-ai-writing-prompt
title: Clean AI Writing: Audit and Rewrite AI-Sounding Text
shortDescription: Flags the patterns that make work writing read as AI-generated and rewrites it in plain, specific language while keeping the writer's voice.
longDescription: Paste an email, Teams message, meeting recap, report, documentation or LinkedIn post and Copilot flags AI writing patterns (overused words, em dashes, formulaic sentence shapes, filler transitions, chatbot leftovers) with a severity, then rewrites the text with rules tuned to that type of work text and runs a second pass. A flag-only mode lists the issues without changing the text.
